reviews.snippet:
We ate here a total of 3 times. We genuinely loved the food and it sat very well with us.
The staff is very friendly and they helped us choose the meals based on our food intolerances.
Some of the dishes need slight improvement and please make sure to always use fresh, clean ingredients.

We noticed the 10% service charge too late and would have complained if we would have seen it on time. We were never informed about such charge, which is not ethical.
